title: The Burning Sigil
author: Emrys Almeida
blurb: Felix Yarrow, a thief who steals memories, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
